title: Indirect-detection constraints on TeV inelastic dark matter after LZ: gamma-rays, antiprotons and the CMB
question: For the corpus-favoured DM readings of the LZ event - 1 TeV Higgsino (delta ~ 366 keV), pseudo-Dirac fermion with a light dark photon (alpha_D from the relic density), contact magnetic-dipole L10 WIMP - what annihilation cross-sections and final states are predicted and do recalled Fermi-LAT dSph, H.E.S.S. GC, AMS-02 antiproton and Planck CMB bounds exclude them?
headline_result: The 1 TeV Higgsino annihilates only to WW+ZZ at 9.6e-27 cm^3/s (x1-3 Sommerfeld), 1.4-10 below all recalled limits (line 1.2e-28 vs ~4e-28); the relic-normalised dark-photon model has a saturated Sommerfeld factor 6 alpha_D m/m_A' at recombination and Planck excludes m_A' < 9 GeV at 1 TeV (valleys 9-32 GeV, all above 32 GeV allowed), removing P011's delta >= 360 keV corner; the L10 dipole WIMP annihilates >= 3e4 times above bounds and survives only as asymmetric Dirac DM
key_numbers: Higgsino 1 TeV: WW 5.2e-27, ZZ 4.4e-27, total 9.6e-27 (1.1 TeV 7.9e-27); sigv_eff 3.0e-26, Omega h2=0.12 at 1167 GeV; ratios to Fermi/HESS/AMS/Planck 0.10-0.29/0.24-0.72/0.10/0.016; line 1.2e-28 (0.3-0.9 of HESS); 300 GeV 3.1x Fermi. Dark photon: alpha_D=0.0104/0.0346/0.104 (300/1000/3000 GeV), sigv_0=4.4e-26; S_sat(1 TeV)=2081/225/21 at m_A'=0.1/1/10 GeV; S_allowed(CMB)=6.8/23/68; m_A' floors 4.0/9.2 (all>=32)/29 (all>=61) GeV; P011 convention 5.2/19.9 GeV; dSph cascades (uncertain) need >=45 GeV. L10: G=(465 GeV)^-2, sigv(qq)=3.3e-21-2e-20 (dim-6), 2e-17 (dim-8), unitarity 4.9e-22, Omega/Omega_DM=7e-6, 3e4 x qq limit
model_or_mechanism: pure Higgsino WW/ZZ via chargino/chi2 exchange (Majorana threshold formula g_eff^4/8 pi m^2 calibrated on positronium and wino); ADG coannihilation formula; one-loop line estimate; pseudo-Dirac chi1 chi1 -> A'A' with Hulthen-potential Sommerfeld saturation vs Planck p_ann; L10 tensor-operator annihilation, unitarity, asymmetric-DM escape
confidence: medium - cross-sections derived and validated on the thermal mass, but all limits recalled and Sommerfeld/line factors bracketed
